connection.title: Connect to OpenClaw
connection.subtitle: Remote Gateway connection
connection.urlHelp: Use a ws:// address for a trusted private network or wss:// for a secure remote endpoint.
connection.secureStorage: The credential is encrypted with your operating system credential store.

connection.credentialsInUrl: Do not include credentials in the Gateway URL.
connection.unauthorized: Authentication failed. Check the token or password.
